subject: CloudBridge x Redwood — Next steps + proposed demo / technical deep dive
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CloudBridge x Redwood — Next steps + proposed demo / technical deep dive

Samir — thanks again for the productive call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get the technical deep dive on the calendar:

Recap:
- Primary use case: serve product-search embeddings via Redwood for CloudBridge marketplace customers, target throughput ~100 qps, P95 latency <150ms.
- Data flow: customer data lives in their VPC; requirement for private deployment / dedicated capacity came up.
- Key success criteria: predictable latency, enterprise-grade audit logs, and a clear mutual action plan for marketplace onboarding.

Proposed next steps:
1) Technical deep dive / partner-led demo (60 min) — cover deployment options, network/connectivity checklist, and integration touchpoints (Marketplace connector).
2) Follow-up: draft mutual action plan + procurement timeline and high-level SOW.

Availability (PT) — please confirm which works for your team and whether you'd like this partner-led or a joint session with our SEs:
- Tue 30 Mar, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed 31 Mar, 14:00–15:00 PT (preferred for our SEs)

Suggested attendees:
- CloudBridge: Samir (you), Emily (Marketplace lead)
- Redwood: Marissa (AE), Dev (Solutions Engineer), Lauren (Partner Ops)

I attached a short demo agenda and an example SOW outline for context (redwood-demo-agenda.pdf). If you can confirm time and any other internal folks to include, I’ll send a calendar invite and a shared mutual-action doc.

Thanks — look forward to locking this in.

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0124

Attachment: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear summary. Wed 31 Mar 14:00–15:00 PT works well for our side. Please go ahead and set that as the tentative time.

A few notes from my side:
- I’ll invite Emily (Marketplace integrations) to the call — she’s cc’d here.
- Can you confirm whether the session will cover the marketplace connector architecture (VPC peering vs. private link) and any sample payload schema we should prepare?
- Our SE (external) would like Dev to lead the network and deployment portion — can your Dev be on the call for that segment?

If you can send a calendar invite and link to the mutual action plan, I’ll get our procurement and security leads to review post-call.

Onward —
